facts.fact: UNICEF Somalia says the digital CRVS system, piloted in 19 districts in 2023 and scaled to 48 districts in 2025, is used daily to register births, though not all regions have it.
UNICEF Somalia says the digital CRVS system is deployed with full operational capability for daily registration of vital events such as births and deaths.
